summary: IHS Holding Limited furnished a Form 6-K containing a supplemental notice confirming that conditions to its previously announced conditional redemption of $200 million in aggregate principal amount of its 5.625% Senior Notes due 2026 have been satisfied, making the redemption irrevocable. An initial notice was issued August 25, 2026; the supplemental notice dated September 9, 2026, sets the redemption date of September 9, 2026, and redemption price of 100.000% of principal plus accrued interest from May 29, 2026. This is a routine debt redemption, not a special situation.
